column1: # NMMiner NM-TV-154 4 MB flash layout for the full-feature firmware.
# Two OTA app slots + 192 KiB LittleFS. The larger app slots make room for
# retaining OTA updates. ASCII glyphs are built in; Hangul bitmap tables are not.
# This layout differs from partitions/smalltv_4mb_ota.csv. Install it with the
# merged firmware.factory.bin over USB; an app-only OTA cannot change partitions.
